_comment: kGroupRows consecutive query rows share one 64-token KV page per wave when their block-table entries agree (the EAGLE verify tokens of a request always do), so the KV tile, its LDS reads and the per-tile sequence are paid once for kGroupRows rows. Measured 192 rows: 1.383 -> 0.878 ms at 32K and 5.54 -> 2.98 ms at 128K, bit-identical to paged_mqa_logits. Set group_rows to 0 to keep the ungrouped kernel.
